derivationRules: Micro is derived from the canonical 24px Line master.
Semantic identity and canonical naming never change.
Remove secondary detail before altering the primary contour.
Merge or omit geometry only when recognition improves at 12px or 16px.
Preserve directional terminals and interaction cues.
Protect critical counters and negative-space gaps.
Micro geometry may be optically rebalanced, but never becomes a second semantic source.

icons.name: bug
icons.review: Legs remain as the recognition cue while the antennae are sacrificed first at dense sizes.

icons.name: calendar
icons.review: Calendar frame, header line and binding posts carry the semantic silhouette without tiny date counters.

icons.name: camera
icons.review: The lens is optically enlarged so the camera remains immediately legible at 12px.

icons.name: delete
icons.review: The container and lid remain; interior slats are non-essential at Micro sizes.

icons.name: file-plus
icons.review: File silhouette plus the creation cue are retained; the fold seam is secondary.

icons.name: refresh
icons.review: A single clockwise loop with a strong terminal reads more reliably than two competing arrows at 12px.

icons.name: settings
icons.review: A radial six/eight-tooth treatment keeps the settings cue while reducing the dense outer contour; the centre opening remains protected.

icons.name: volume
icons.review: Speaker body plus one wave preserves the sound cue without stacking two low-resolution arcs.
